name: base
description: The language: control flow, async boundaries and the task protocol. Every renderer implements it; functions and effects are in vocabulary.json.

components.name: Html
components.description: The root of an html blok (a panel, a dashboard, a popout's page): lays its children out as a fragment does, and names the blok's context.

components.name: ask
components.description: The open ask of the task this blok is about (`task.ask`), as the form its ports generate: answered right here, which resumes the task. Shows nothing while no ask is open. Replaces TaskAsk.

components.name: case
components.description: One branch of a `match`: its children render when the matched value is `is`.

props.description: The literal this case matches, or a list of them.

components.name: default
components.description: The branch of a `match` that renders when no `case` matches.

components.name: else
components.description: A branch of its `if`: an else-if with `when`, the default without. Only the last `else` may go without `when`.

props.description: The else-if condition; the default branch when absent.

components.name: error
components.description: What a `suspense` shows when a read inside it failed; the error is readable as `error` (`error.message`).

components.name: fallback
components.description: What a `suspense` shows while a read inside it is pending.

components.name: foreach
components.description: Renders its children once per item, the item bound to `let`; each item's subtree takes its ids from `key`, or from its position without one.

props.description: A stable key per item (`key={p.id}`): what an item's ids, kept values and diffs follow. Left out, items are keyed by their position (<id>@#<n>), which suits scalars only.
The loop variable: a plain name, read bare inside.

components.name: fragment
components.description: Groups children without rendering anything of its own.

components.name: if
components.description: Renders its children (the then-branch) when `when` holds; its trailing `else` children are the else-if and default branches. Only the active branch is rendered and read.

components.name: match
components.description: Renders the first `case` whose `is` equals `value`, else its `default`.

components.name: suspense
components.description: A boundary: while any read inside is pending it shows its `fallback`, when one failed its `error` (with the error as `error`); stale values render, dimmed. The nearest boundary catches.
